## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes (types, lint, strings, unit tests and their coverage)
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e` passes in Chromium and Firefox
- [ ] New behaviour has tests
- [ ] New strings are in `src/locales/en.json` and use the interface terms (rule, condition, limit), not the code words
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md`, the README, the privacy policy and Help updated where the change affects them
- [ ] No network requests of the extension's own, no remote code, no analytics
